inherits.scope: The MC6803 has the MC6801 digital CPU and peripheral behavior when operated in manufacturer-defined Modes 2 or 3.
restrictions: Only expanded multiplexed Modes 2 and 3 are implemented and claimed.
Mode 0 ROM contents are undefined and are not supplied.
Operation in modes other than 0, 2, and 3 is undefined by the manufacturer.

memory_regions.access: 0004-0007 and 000F are external in Modes 2 and 3; remaining implemented registers are internal
internal in Mode 2 when RAME=1; external in Mode 3 or when RAME=0
read-write; interrupt and reset vectors are externally fetched

operating_modes.mode2: expanded multiplexed ROMless operation with internal RAM controlled by RAME
operating_modes.mode3: expanded multiplexed ROMless/RAMless operation with the RAM window external
operating_modes.mode0: manufacturer test operation whose internal ROM contents are UNDEFINED_BY_DOCUMENTATION and outside the claimed Modes 2/3 profile
operating_modes.other_modes: undefined by manufacturer documentation and rejected by the public MC6803 profile

reference.locator: section 2.4.2, printed page 2-21; figures 2-10 and 2-11, printed pages 2-12 to 2-13

implementation_scope.rtl: rtl/m6801/mc6801_mcu.sv with OPERATING_MODE equal to 2 or 3
implementation_scope.verification: The same Mode 2/3 integration vectors are applicable because the manufacturer defines functional identity for these modes.
implementation_scope.physical_interface: The normalized external-memory interface does not claim the Port 3/Port 4 multiplexed pin waveform.
implementation_scope.undefined_mode_behavior: No deterministic behavior is assigned to manufacturer-undefined modes or Mode 0 ROM contents.
